options.title: GTA 6 costs $79.99. How many copies is Take-Two counting on? 🎮
options.first_line: GTA Six costs {fact1}. So how many copies is Take-Two counting on by New Year?
options.first_frame: A game shop at night: a big drawn GTA VI box on the shelf with a yellow $79.99 price tag swinging, the Take-Two logo sticker beside it, Rohan's hand reaching for the box.

options.title: Take-Two just launched GTA 6. How many copies does it need? 🎮
options.first_line: Take-Two, the company behind Grand Theft Auto, just launched GTA Six. How many copies does its own forecast add up to?
options.first_frame: The Take-Two logo sticker big on a launch-night stage, a queue of gamers below it holding drawn GTA VI boxes, confetti falling.

options.title: You pay $79.99 for GTA 6. Take-Two is counting on millions of you 🎮
options.first_line: You pay {fact1} for one copy of GTA Six. How many of you is Take-Two counting on by New Year?
options.first_frame: Rohan on his sofa tearing the wrapper off one drawn GTA VI box, the $79.99 receipt floating up, a Take-Two logo sticker on the TV behind him.

why: It names the thing you buy and its price, asks a question you can only answer by staying (unlike C, whose title already hints at millions), and its first frame of a swinging price tag on a GTA VI box reads without sound.
